signal_summary: Treasure Valley Family YMCA is finishing the $80 million, 109,000 square foot CapEd Downtown Boise YMCA at 10th and State streets; the Y build page and its RunSignUp event page (observed Sep 23, 2026) set the grand opening and a Grand Opening Walk for Saturday Nov 7, 2026 at the Downtown Boise YMCA, 1050 W State St.
purchase_use_case_evidence: Registration for the Nov 7, 2026 Grand Opening Walk includes a commemorative Grand Opening T Shirt with extra shirts sold through the event store, and the move into a 109,000 square foot downtown Boise facility points to staff apparel for front desk, aquatics, fitness and child care teams.
reason_to_contact: The Y has set the grand opening of the $80 million, 109,000 square foot CapEd Downtown Boise YMCA and a community Grand Opening Walk for Saturday Nov 7, 2026 in downtown Boise, and walk registration already bundles a commemorative shirt.
recommended_offer: Grand opening event shirts and giveaways plus refreshed staff apparel for front desk, aquatics, fitness and child care teams at the new downtown Boise facility.
suggested_opening_line: I saw the Y set the CapEd Downtown Boise YMCA Grand Opening Walk for Nov 7 with a commemorative shirt in every registration. Who is coordinating event shirts and new staff apparel for the downtown opening?
next_question: Does the association office buy apparel for every branch, or does each branch director order for its own staff and events?
outreach_caveat: The build page and RunSignUp page are undated, so the observation date (Sep 23, 2026) stands in for the published date while the event itself is dated Nov 7, 2026. The walk shirt may already be sourced, so lead with staff apparel for the new building and later Y events. Andersen Construction, an excluded account, is only the builder; the Y is the owner operator.
research_notes: Grand opening date confirmed on the Y build page and on the RunSignUp Grand Opening Walk page; address and phone from the Y contact page; Apollo lookup matches the Y domain. An Idaho Press story on the building nearing completion was left out because its publish date could not be confirmed before the web search budget ran out. The Y is an independent nonprofit member association of the national YMCA federation, not a franchise with centrally supplied apparel. An undated Y hiring post mentions branches in Boise, Meridian and Caldwell, but only the downtown Boise address was confirmed, so local site count is 1.

sources.supporting_text: The CapEd Downtown Boise YMCA Grand Opening Walk is set for Saturday Nov 7, 2026 at the Downtown Boise YMCA, 1050 W State St, for all ages; registration includes a commemorative Grand Opening T Shirt and extra shirts are sold through the event store.
Build page describes the $80 million, 109,000 square foot CapEd Downtown Boise YMCA at 10th and State streets as on track for a late 2026 opening and states the grand opening is Nov 7.
Contact page lists the Downtown Boise YMCA at 1050 W State Street, Boise ID 83702, phone 208 344 5501.

signal_summary: BoiseDev community calendar lists an Eagle Chamber ribbon cutting for Vista Bank, formerly Hillcrest Bank, on Aug 6, 2026 at the 80 E Eagles Gate Dr banking center in Eagle, and the Boise Metro Chamber posted a new event notice that Hillcrest Bank is changing its name to Vista Bank.
purchase_use_case_evidence: The Vista Bank welcome page for Hillcrest clients says the name changes at banking centers, on the website and in the mobile app while the Hillcrest teams stay in place, and the Eagle ribbon cutting on Aug 6, 2026 put that new name in front of the local chamber, a fit for relabeled staff apparel and branded client giveaways at the Eagle branch.
reason_to_contact: Eagle Chamber ribbon cutting on Aug 6, 2026 marked the Eagle banking center at 80 E Eagles Gate Dr switching from Hillcrest Bank to Vista Bank, a name change that touches staff apparel, branch giveaways and community event merchandise for the Idaho team.
recommended_offer: Vista Bank logo staff apparel for the Eagle banking center team plus branded giveaways for client appreciation and chamber events.
suggested_opening_line: I saw the Eagle Chamber ribbon cutting on Aug 6, 2026 for Vista Bank, formerly Hillcrest Bank, at your Eagles Gate Dr banking center. Is the Eagle team still filling gaps in staff wear and client giveaways under the new name?
next_question: Does the Eagle branch order its own event and staff apparel locally, or does NBH Bank corporate marketing supply everything carrying the Vista Bank logo?
outreach_caveat: Vista Bank is a division of NBH Bank under National Bank Holdings Corporation, so rebrand apparel may be supplied centrally by the parent bank. The ribbon cutting on Aug 6, 2026 has passed, so lead with local event and community merchandise and confirm whether the Idaho team buys locally. Only the Eagle banking center is documented in scope. Publish dates of the calendar and chamber listings are not shown; the event date carries the signal.
research_notes: Searches run Sep 23, 2026 returned the BoiseDev calendar listing for the Eagle Chamber ribbon cutting dated Aug 6, 2026 and the Boise Metro Chamber new event post on the Hillcrest to Vista name change. Address, phone and weekday hours come from the official Eagle location page on the Hillcrest domain, now titled Vista Bank. Parent is NBH Bank, a subsidiary of National Bank Holdings Corporation, per the Vista Bank site. Merger coverage from 2025 and the January 2026 closing release were left out under the date rule. The Idaho Hispanic Chamber post named in the sourcing note was not confirmed and is not cited. Apollo lookup confirms the vistabank.com domain.
